description: A theme assigns literal colors to host-defined token ids.

agent_colors.description: Muted OKLCH family for agent chats: one hue, with each chat a lightness step from main. The client enforces display contrast.

chroma.description: OKLCH saturation of every agent color.

main.description: Center of the agent family; defaults to text-muted.

bevel.description: How strongly raised and recessed controls show their edges. The host derives every edge's color; a theme sets only their strength.

strength.description: Multiplier on every edge's alpha. 1 keeps the product's edges, 0 flattens every control, 2 doubles them.

brand.description: What a theme may say about product identity. One key, and it carries a visibility rather than artwork: a theme may quiet the product logomark and can never substitute one.

logomark.description: Whether the product logomark paints. Hiding reserves its box, so a theme swap never relayouts the window.

icons.description: The glyph surface: a theme-wide stroke treatment plus per-slot geometry. The frame — grid, size, paint, and each slot's base weight — stays the host's.

geometry.description: Per-slot glyph replacement. Partial: an unset slot keeps the host glyph.

accent.description: Accent fill behind on-accent labels (primary buttons).

accent-hover.description: The accent fill under the pointer. Deepens toward `shadow` when unset, in both schemes: `on-accent` is a light ink, so a hover that lifts the fill takes the label with it. Gated against `on-accent`. Optional: derived from other tokens when unset.

accent-signal.description: Accent indicators, icons, and links. Also the product lockup bars, which must stay visible on `brand-field`. Optional: derived from other tokens when unset.

accent-text.description: Accent-colored copy on a surface, not a fill. Optional: derived from other tokens when unset.

accent-warm.description: Secondary accent fill for call-to-action surfaces. Optional: derived from other tokens when unset.

accent-warm-hover.description: `accent-warm` under the pointer, on the same terms as `accent-hover`. Optional: derived from other tokens when unset.

background.description: Page backdrop behind every surface. Must be opaque.

border.description: Hairline rules and control outlines. Optional: derived from other tokens when unset.

brand-field.description: The plate behind the product lockup bars. The product black when unset. A palette that wants the bars on the chrome sets this to that plane, or transparent. Gated against `accent-signal` so the bars cannot vanish into it. Optional: derived from other tokens when unset.

caret.description: Text insertion caret in the editor and inputs. Body ink when unset, which is what a browser does on its own; a theme that wants the caret to read as its own mark sets it. Optional: derived from other tokens when unset.

cost-coordinator.description: Cost series: coordinator share. Optional: derived from other tokens when unset.

cost-summarizer.description: Cost series: summarizer share. Optional: derived from other tokens when unset.

cost-workers.description: Cost series: worker share. Optional: derived from other tokens when unset.

danger-text.description: Destructive and error copy on a surface, as opposed to the fill. Derived from `danger`, darkened or lightened only as far as the legibility floor requires. Optional: derived from other tokens when unset.

diff-add-hue.description: Hue for added lines. Separate from status-positive so a theme can make diffs colorblind-safe without changing success. Optional: derived from other tokens when unset.

diff-delete-hue.description: Hue for removed lines. Separate from danger, same reason. Optional: derived from other tokens when unset.

draft-accent.description: Coordinator draft and orchestration rail. Optional: derived from other tokens when unset.

draft-accent-text.description: Draft-rail copy, quieter than the rail itself. Optional: derived from other tokens when unset.

identity-1.description: Project identity hue 1. The identity set exists to make projects distinguishable at a glance, so the hues stay far apart. Optional: derived from other tokens when unset.

identity-2.description: Project identity hue 2. Optional: derived from other tokens when unset.

identity-3.description: Project identity hue 3. Optional: derived from other tokens when unset.

identity-4.description: Project identity hue 4. Optional: derived from other tokens when unset.

identity-5.description: Project identity hue 5. Optional: derived from other tokens when unset.

on-accent.description: Label ink on an accent fill. Optional: derived from other tokens when unset.

on-accent-warm.description: Label ink on a warm accent fill. Its own decision rather than `on-accent`'s: a palette is free to put the two accents on opposite sides of the luminance line, and then no single ink is readable on both. Optional: derived from other tokens when unset.

selection.description: Fill behind a selected row, rail item, or segment. Opaque: it sits on the page or a track, so a theme names the color it wants rather than a strength of the accent. Optional: derived from other tokens when unset.

selection-strong.description: Fill behind a selected text range. Heavier than a row selection, which reads from its whole band; a text range has to show its extent character by character. Optional: derived from other tokens when unset.

shadow.description: The ink elevation shadows are cast in. Body ink on light; true black on dark. Optional: derived from other tokens when unset.

status-positive-text.description: Success copy on a surface, as opposed to the fill. Optional: derived from other tokens when unset.

status-running.description: In-flight work; distinct from both accent and success. Optional: derived from other tokens when unset.

surface.description: Panel and card fill. Optional: derived from other tokens when unset.

surface-chrome.description: The plane window chrome sits on: the nav rail, its title bar, and the resize seam that carries the divider. Recessed or lifted relative to the page is the theme's choice — what matters is that chrome reads as frame rather than content. Flat with the page when unset. Setting it moves every mark on the rail with it, not just the fill: see [Planes](#planes). Must be opaque. Optional: derived from other tokens when unset.

surface-elevated.description: Raised surface (menus, popovers). Optional: derived from other tokens when unset.

surface-inset.description: The track a control is recessed into: a segmented picker or an editor tab strip. The opposite direction from `surface-elevated`. The chosen segment paints `selection` on this track; unchosen labels sit on the track itself. Not a plane: a track's contents keep their own color rather than blending into it, so nothing here follows `--den-plane`. Flat with the page when unset. Optional: derived from other tokens when unset.

surface-offset.description: Wash a seated block sits on — the project cluster, a segmented track. One step off the page: down on light, up on dark. Must be opaque. Optional: derived from other tokens when unset.

surface-raised.description: Plane of something lifted out of a well — the chosen segment in a track. Must read above surface-offset, not below it. Must be opaque. Optional: derived from other tokens when unset.

text.description: Body ink on background and surface.

text-muted.description: Secondary ink: captions, metadata, placeholders. Optional: derived from other tokens when unset.

tint-hue.description: Neutral hover hue; the tint ramp derives from it. Optional: derived from other tokens when unset.

warning-text.description: Caution copy on a surface, as opposed to the fill. Optional: derived from other tokens when unset.

window_colors.description: Generative OKLCH family for window cursors, selections, and labels. Omitted anchors derive from the theme; the client enforces display contrast.

chroma_max.description: Upper OKLCH chroma bound; gamut and contrast may reduce it.

chroma_min.description: Lower OKLCH chroma bound; must not exceed chroma_max.

hue_spread.description: Maximum hue excursion from each anchor, in degrees.

main.description: Main window identity color; defaults to accent-signal. Display contrast is enforced.
